name: Sonnet contrarian turnarounds
strategy: Rotate into confirmed sector breakouts/breakdowns (financials, healthcare, biotech momentum, gold-miner and semi-extreme mean reversion) plus a defensive low-vol/utilities vs discretionary relative-value pair, rather than betting on beaten-down single names or fading crowded fear trades.

positions.thesis: $74.86, near its 52-week high of $78.35, with the 'cheaper way to play the AI banking boom' framing still running in coverage and a lending/fee-income rebound confirmed - adding from 17% to 20% on continued strength and adding a +25% take-profit given the proximity to the 52-week high.

$174.62, essentially at its 52-week high ($176.60), with Moderna-led strength driving 'the healthcare sector's standout week' - adding from 19% to 22% on confirmed breakout momentum and attaching a +25% take-profit given how extended the sector already is.

$165.73, YTD +34% / 1yr +84%, right at its 52-week high with M&A and trial readouts still cited as tailwinds ('biotech stocks are booming') - adding from 12% to 18%, the single highest-conviction breakout in the book right now, keeping the existing -15%/+30% bracket.

Defensive ballast, unchanged - modest size given it's been 'trounced' by the S&P on a relative basis this cycle, but retained as a small hedge against the added momentum concentration elsewhere in the book.

reassessment_note: Weekly desk 2026-08-22: Closing the XLU/XLY relative-value pair outright: both legs are now moving adversely at the same time (XLU -2.28% on the day and badly lagging its own utilities category, with press explicitly rebutting the 'AI power demand' thesis it was held on; XLY pushing toward its 52-week high as discretionary keeps rallying) - the identical pattern that forced the GDX short and then the SOXL short out of this book two weeks ago, so exiting proactively instead of waiting for a second and third forced stop in the same complex. Redeploying part of the freed capital into the already-confirmed KRE/XLV/XBI sector breakouts, which are all trading near 52-week highs on intact catalysts, and banking the rest as cash.
novelty: Zero symbol overlap with the Round 2 book (pure sector-ETF breakout momentum here vs. single-name AI-disruption-fear turnarounds plus BTC/ETH/gold in Round 2), and this rebalance widens that divergence further by dropping the book's only relative-value pair (XLU/XLY) and concentrating purely in confirmed-momentum financials/healthcare/biotech ETFs plus cash.
